core_principles: Lots of whitespace, rounded corners, soft shadows, large typography
Real product photography treated deliberately (spotlight, clipped frames)

headings.description: Modern, friendly yet premium geometric sans. Creates a professional but approachable feel.
headings.usage: H1 to H4. Tracking tight for larger sizes.

body.description: Highly legible, comfortable, and clean sans-serif for reading.
body.usage: Paragraphs, labels, button text, subtle UI elements.

editorial_accents.description: Used ONLY for signature moments, large statistic numbers, and numbered manifesto chapters.
editorial_accents.usage: Large numbers, quotes, special artistic typography moments.

colors.rules: STRICT COLOR SYSTEM. ONLY these colors. 80% Neutral, 15% White, 5% Accent. Accent used ONLY to highlight important actions.

background.usage: Main page background. Deep, near-black neutral.

surface.usage: Cards, drawers, accordion bodies, admin panels.

border.usage: Separators, card borders, input borders. Essential for defining structure without glassmorphism.

primary_text.usage: Headings, primary body text, active state icons.

secondary_text.usage: Supporting descriptions, disabled states, placeholders, metadata.

primary_accent.usage: Primary CTA buttons, active states, progress indicators. Used very sparingly (5%).

secondary.usage: Secondary buttons (hover states), subtle highlights, pill badges.

navbar.structure: Sticky on scroll, Solid background #080D10 with bottom border #23262B. NO logo image. Typography only 'VEYORA / Creative Studio'.

buttons.primary: bg-[#5C6773] text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium hover:brightness-110 transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#23262B] text-[#FFFFFF] rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium hover:bg-[#121417] transition-all

cards.service_card: bg-[#121417] border border-[#23262B] rounded-2xl p-8 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform. Includes image, title, short desc, starting price, estimated time, and 'View Detail' secondary button.
cards.portfolio_card: Image focused, rounded-xl overflow-hidden group. Image scales slightly on hover. Title and category appear on hover or sit below image.

side_drawer.usage: Portfolio details open in a drawer (not new page).
side_drawer.style: bg-[#121417] border-l border-[#23262B] w-full md:w-[600px] h-full shadow-2xl p-8.
side_drawer.content: Gallery, Overview, Challenge, Solution, Deliverables, Related Service, CTA.

accordion.style: bg-transparent border-b border-[#23262B]. Title text-[#FFFFFF], content text-[#A3AAB4].

motion_and_interaction.scrolling: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. Feels premium and weighty.
motion_and_interaction.hero_reveal: Signature on-load moment: Masked line-by-line reveal of the H1 text. Staggered fade up for supporting elements.
motion_and_interaction.parallax: Subtle parallax on the hero large product/device mockup. Spotlight effect moving slightly with mouse.
motion_and_interaction.marquee: One slow editorial marquee (e.g., 'Creative Partner • Brand Identity • Visual Design') using Playfair Display, text-[#23262B] or text-[#121417] large outline typography running infinitely.
motion_and_interaction.micro_interactions: Buttons scale slightly down on click. Images in portfolio scale 1.05 on hover. Substantive but not distracting.

homepage_flow: Hero: Headline, supporting description, primary CTA, secondary CTA, large product mockup, trust indicators.
Portfolio: Modern grid with categories (Packaging, Logo, etc.). Clicking opens Side Drawer.
Final CTA: Large text, minimal, primary button.

admin_panel.style: bg-[#080D10] text-white. Sidebar nav bg-[#121417]. Clean Shadcn-based data tables, forms with #23262B borders. Strict adherence to color palette. Dense layout for productivity.

media_and_images.treatment: Real product photography treated deliberately. Use clipped frames, dramatic spotlighting. No generic vectors.

hero_mockup.description: Minimal packaging white box with black label. Excellent for the large spotlight mockup in hero.

portfolio_item_1.description: Close up of a premium business card. Represents Brand Identity/Logo service.

process_designer.description: Black laptop computer on brown wooden table in a dark room. Good for Working Process section.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: All text must pass WCAG AA. Primary text #FFFFFF against #080D10 passes easily. Accent #5C6773 must only be used on #FFFFFF text or as background for white text where contrast is sufficient.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, accordion triggers) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. DO NOT invent new shades of gray. Stick to #080D10, #121417, #23262B, #A3AAB4, #FFFFFF.
Ensure no completely transparent backgrounds over scrolling content (e.g., sticky navbar must have solid #080D10 background).
Implement Framer Motion for the line-by-line masked text reveal in the hero section.
Ensure the Portfolio section triggers a side drawer (using Shadcn Sheet or custom Framer Motion drawer), NOT a new route.
Keep spacing highly generous (py-24 or py-32 for sections) to maintain the premium feel.
Build a separate robust Admin CMS using Shadcn components matching the dark theme.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not apply `transition: all` to everything, be specific.
Do not center-align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }` is forbidden).
Never use placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com) for images.
Ensure layering creates depth without relying on colorful gradients or heavy glassmorphism.
